title: Sanlorenzo SX88
highlights: Garage for tender and water toys
description:
The 2024 Sanlorenzo SX88 is a 26.7-metre crossover yacht blending explorer versatility with superyacht elegance. Conceived as a floating beach house, she offers a multi-level beach area, a terrace layout and floor-to-ceiling salon windows.

She accommodates eight guests in four cabins, including a full-beam owner's cabin on the main deck, with a garage for tender and toys and three Volvo Penta IPS 1050 drives. She carries about € 850,000 of factory options and is lying in Marmaris, Turkey.
